uploadErrors.NOT_A_ZIP: That file isn't a valid .zip. Compress your game's folder into a .zip and upload it again.

uploadErrors.DUPLICATE_PATH: Two files have the same name, differing only in case or accents: “{path}”. Keep just one.
uploadErrors.PATH_CONFLICT: “{path}” is both a file and a folder. Rename one of them.
uploadErrors.ENCRYPTED_ENTRY: The .zip has password-protected files (“{path}”). Compress it again without a password.
uploadErrors.UNSUPPORTED_COMPRESSION: The .zip uses a compression method we don't support (“{path}”). Compress it again with the standard method (Deflate).
uploadErrors.OVERLAPPING_ENTRIES: The .zip has an invalid internal structure (“{path}”). Compress your game again with a common program.
uploadErrors.SYMLINK_NOT_ALLOWED: The .zip has a shortcut or symbolic link (“{path}”). Replace it with the real file.
uploadErrors.SPECIAL_FILE: The .zip has a special file that isn't a regular file (“{path}”). Remove it and compress again.
uploadErrors.EXECUTABLE_FILE: We don't accept executable programs (“{path}”). Trafal only hosts games that play in the browser.
uploadErrors.NESTED_ARCHIVE: We don't accept compressed archives inside the .zip (“{path}”). Unpack it and upload its files directly.
uploadErrors.EXTENSION_NOT_ALLOWED: We don't accept “{extension}” files (“{path}”). Remove it from the .zip or switch to a common web format.
uploadErrors.NO_INDEX_HTML: The file {file} is missing from the main folder. It's the one that opens your game in the browser: it must be at the root of the .zip.

terms.consent: I am {age} or older and I accept the current <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
terms.decline: Don't want to accept them? You can <delete>delete your account</delete>.

errors.generic: We could not save your acceptance. Try again.

banner.text: We updated the terms and the privacy policy. Accept them to keep using your account.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: What is happening with your games, your updates and your account.
notifications.empty: You have no notifications yet. When someone comments, replies, follows you or likes something of yours, it shows up here.
notifications.allRead: Done, everything is marked as read
notifications.error: We couldn't do it. Try again.

moderation.appealUpheld: We reviewed your appeal: the decision was kept
moderation.appealOverturned: We reviewed your appeal: we reversed the decision
moderation.counterUpheld: We reviewed your counter-notice: the content stays hidden
moderation.counterOverturned: We reviewed your counter-notice: we published the content again

claims.title: Copyright claim
claims.subtitle: If you own rights and believe something published on Trafal infringes them, fill in this form. The team reviews it and, if it applies, hides the content.
claims.noteAccount: You do not need an account.
claims.notePrivacy: Only the Trafal team sees your details: they are not shown to whoever published the content.
claims.name: Your full name
claims.emailHint: It is the only way we can write to you.
claims.work: Which work is yours and why you think it was copied
claims.workHint: Describe the work and how it shows that it was used without permission (10 to 2000 characters).
claims.urls: Links to what you are claiming on Trafal
claims.urlsHint: One per line, up to 10. At least one must be a game or an update on Trafal, for example {example}.
claims.goodFaith: I believe in good faith that the use of the work is not authorized by its owner, its agent or the law.
claims.accuracy: I declare that the information in this claim is accurate and that I own the rights or am authorized to act on their behalf.
claims.signatureHint: It counts as the signature of the two statements above.

sent.title: We got your claim
sent.text: The team will review it. Your reference number is {reference}: keep it in case you need to contact us.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can be up to 120 characters.
errors.orgTooLong: The organization name can be up to 120 characters.
errors.descriptionTooShort: Tell us a bit more: at least 10 characters.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can be up to 2000 characters.
errors.originalUrlInvalid: Type a full link starting with http:// or https://.
errors.urlsTooMany: You can add up to 10 links.
errors.urlInvalid: Each line must be a full link starting with http:// or https://.
errors.urlsNotOnSite: None of the links is a published game or update on Trafal.
errors.statementsRequired: You have to tick both statements.
errors.signatureRequired: Type your full name as the signature.
errors.tooManyClaims: We got too many claims from this email or from the site in a short time. Try again later.
errors.generic: We couldn't send the claim. Try again.
errors.captchaFailed: We couldn't check that you are a person. Wait for the check to finish and try again.
errors.captchaUnavailable: The security check is not available right now. Try again in a while.

appeals.title: Moderation
appeals.subtitle: The decisions the team took about your account or your content, and your appeals.
appeals.how: If you think a decision was a mistake, you can appeal it once. An admin reviews it and answers you here and with a notification. If they agree with you, the decision is reversed.
appeals.decisionsEmpty: There is no decision in force about your account or your content.

appealStatus.upheld: Appeal answered: the decision was kept
appealStatus.overturned: Appeal answered: the decision was reversed

appeals.appealsEmpty: You have not appealed any decision yet.

dialog.title: Appeal this decision
dialog.text: Tell us why you think it was a mistake. An admin will review it and answer you. You can only appeal each decision once.
dialog.label: Your message
dialog.sent: We received your appeal. We will let you know when we have an answer.

errors.messageRequired: Write why you think it was a mistake.
errors.nothingToAppeal: There is nothing left to appeal: the decision changed.
errors.alreadyAppealed: This decision already has an appeal.
errors.tooManyOpen: You have too many appeals under review. Wait until we answer one.
errors.generic: We could not send your appeal. Try again.
errors.statementsRequired: Check both statements to send the counter-notice.
errors.counterNoticeRequired: This was hidden because of a copyright claim: answer with a counter-notice.
errors.notAClaim: This was not hidden because of a copyright claim.

counter.title: Counter-notice
counter.text: This was hidden because of a copyright claim. If you believe in good faith that it was a mistake or that the wrong work was identified, tell us why. An admin compares your answer with the claim and decides whether it is published again. You can only answer once.
counter.message: Why you think it was a mistake
counter.name: Your full name
counter.privacy: If needed, we pass your name and this email to whoever made the claim so you can get in touch. We do not give you their details.
counter.goodFaith: I believe in good faith that this was hidden by mistake or by misidentifying the work.
counter.accuracy: What I wrote is accurate and I am the one who published this content.
counter.sent: We received your counter-notice. We will let you know when we have an answer.
counter.note: This was hidden because of a copyright claim: you answer it with a counter-notice.
